submission.summary:
POST /api/orders started returning 504s at about 19:49:27 UTC, when order-service was rolled out (revision 6). The new pods set INVENTORY_TIMEOUT to 1ms instead of 1s, so almost every reserve-stock call to inventory-service times out before it can answer. The gateway turns these into 5xx responses, which pushed the route's error ratio above the 5% alert threshold. Inventory-service itself is healthy (p95 about 5-20 ms).</summary>
<parameter name="root_causes">[{"component": "order-service", "category": "bad_config_value", "explanation": "Revision 6 of the order-service Deployment (rolled out 19:49:27 UTC, ReplicaSet order-service-867865557d) sets INVENTORY_TIMEOUT=1ms; revision 5 had 1s. A 1ms client deadline is far below the normal inventory reserve latency, so CreateOrder fails with gRPC DeadlineExceeded ('reserve stock: context deadline exceeded') before inventory-service responds. The gateway returns 504 for POST /api/orders. Only the order-creation path is affected; the GET routes are unaffected.", "confidence": "high"}]

evidence.finding: POST /api/orders 5xx: 503 and 504 series rising from about 19:49:46. Successful 201 rate fell from about 1.9/s to 0.34/s by 19:51. Other routes stayed at normal levels.

Gateway logs: 'upstream call failed' upstream=order-service grpc_code=DeadlineExceeded err='reserve stock: context deadline exceeded', then http 504 on POST /api/orders at about 3 ms duration. Order-service logs show the same DeadlineExceeded on /shop.v1.OrderService/CreateOrder during reserve stock.

deploy_history for order-service: revision 6 (ReplicaSet order-service-867865557d) created 2026-11-10T19:49:27Z. Its only env change from revision 5 is INVENTORY_TIMEOUT 1s -> 1ms. Other settings are the same, including PUBLISH_TIMEOUT 500ms and DB_MAX_CONNS 10.

Pod order-service-867865557d-x4ln8 runs with INVENTORY_TIMEOUT=1ms. It started at 11:49:27 PST (19:49:27 UTC), has 0 restarts, and is Ready. The pod's own state is healthy; the failures are client deadlines.
order-service grpc_client_handled_total DeadlineExceeded rate was 0 until about 19:49:44, then rose to about 0.9/s at 19:50:04 and about 2.1/s at 19:51:24.
inventory-service gRPC server p95 latency stayed at about 5-20 ms throughout, including after the change. Inventory is not slow, so the 1ms client timeout is the cause.

timeline.event: order-service revision 6 rolled out (ReplicaSet order-service-867865557d) with INVENTORY_TIMEOUT=1ms, down from 1s.
order-service DeadlineExceeded errors on reserve-stock calls begin.
GatewayErrorRateHigh condition becomes true: POST /api/orders 5xx ratio above 5%.
DeadlineExceeded rate reaches about 0.9/s and keeps rising; successful order creations drop.
Alert paged. POST /api/orders 201 rate is about 0.3/s, down from about 1.9/s.

recommended_actions.rationale: Roll order-service back to revision 5 (ReplicaSet order-service-c778f8c59), which has INVENTORY_TIMEOUT=1s. That restores the reserve-stock deadline to a sensible value and should bring POST /api/orders back to normal. Alternatively, set INVENTORY_TIMEOUT back to 1s on the current deployment.
